notes: The template shows the product only in two places (a picture per step card, a desktop screen per row card); everything else is statements, figures and lists, so it is a type-led fit for a client with few or no pictures.
The opening wants three statements (hero.title, hero.text, hero.text2); with only a title it is one pinned screen.
links[t,d,h] make the row of cards; each takes media.screens[i] when there is one. Without links the row is left out.
The walk is as long as features.items (seven entries = 4 800 px of scroll at 1440); more than about eight is too long.
media.phones, media.video, hero.primary/secondary/kicker/note have no slot here.
media.made.land carries every picture slot; the opening uses dark-toned ones only (its text is light).
A place (restaurant, hotel, shop) is not a fit.
